change.before: "Conflict resolution strategy for service selection differed between environments with Sidecar resources and without; without Sidecar preferred Kubernetes Service, with Sidecar preferred Service in same namespace as proxy"
change.after: "Unified behavior: prefer Service in same namespace as proxy, then Kubernetes Service (not ServiceEntry), else arbitrary selection"

consequence.statement: Service selection and conflict resolution during service processing now follows unified rules regardless of Sidecar resource presence; environments relying on previous behavior differences should verify that the new preference ordering (namespace-local Services first) aligns with their traffic expectations.

assertion.statement: Sidecar resource conflict resolution behavior when processing services is unified in version 1.24.0; service selection strategies now prefer the proxy's namespace and Kubernetes Services regardless of whether a Sidecar resource is defined.
